title: Alert / action threshold rules
description: Machine-readable threshold rules (directive §58). Boundary behaviour is explicit: every rule states what happens BELOW, AT and ABOVE the threshold. Where the controlling document leaves the equality case ambiguous, `atThreshold` MUST be "ReviewRequired" — the application must not invent a radiological interpretation.

atThreshold.description: Use "ReviewRequired" whenever the controlling document does not unambiguously resolve the equality case.

deferPermitted.description: Whether the technician may DEFER the resulting action (§31). A deferred action remains visibly outstanding and blocks Technician Complete unless the rule says otherwise.

outcome.description: ReviewRequired means the software cannot decide and a competent person must. It is never a silent pass.
